name: github-auth
description: Mints short-lived GitHub App installation tokens on the host, from a private key that never enters the container, and authenticates gh/git inside the container with them.

settings.label: GitHub App
settings.description: The github-app the sandbox authenticates as. Its App ID, private key (which never enters the container), GitHub host and the username git and gh use are configured with it, in your authentications.
